keyFindings.description: confirmTopicRecipient counts any dedupeCache record as a confirmation, and the live topics lane (ENVOY_SUBSCRIBE_ALL_TOPICS=1, set by deploy/compose/listener.compose.yml:35 and single-node.compose.yml:61) records the route's own core publish for a portless self-subscribed session it Skipped (delivery.go:800-810, session.go:68-71) in the same cache (main.go:757). Reproduced on the real binary: lane off 504 receipt_timeout in 4.22 s, lane on 200 in 0.22 s for a recipient that never confirmed.

A core publish (or the sender-stamp read) the window cuts short answers 504 not_confirmed with every recipient delivery_failed, and with no registered recipient the body is undelivered [] and the text '0 of 0 sessions ... did not confirm'; nothing names the failed topic publish, the same failure answered fast is a 500 (writeNATSError), and AGENTS.md:2176 documents 200 for a topic with no recipient without this answer.

The PR adds answers at a process boundary (403 capability and 504 receipt_timeout/delivery_failed/not_confirmed on POST /v1/messages/publish, which answered 200; notify.ErrNotDelivered/ErrRefusedByHolder in the daemon) with no '## Contract change census': no search commands, no per-consumer dispositions (envoy-client transport.ts, daemon notify.go, claude-envoy, pi-envoy, scripts/e2e/dispatch-user-turns.sh:455, packages/pi-envoy/scripts/smoke-delivery.sh:217, packages/envoy/scripts/e2e-local.sh:403), and a release-order line that names only the 504 although an earlier daemon also retries the 403 without a cap and fences later notices behind it.
